name: Don Norman
role: Cognitive scientist · The Design of Everyday Things
bio: Don Norman is a cognitive scientist and design researcher best known for The Design of Everyday Things. He co-founded the Nielsen Norman Group, helped establish UC San Diego’s Design Lab, and publishes at jnd.org on humanity-centered design. Public work underpins modern usability and affordance vocabulary.
highlights: Author of The Design of Everyday Things.
Nielsen Norman Group co-founder; UCSD Design Lab.
